title: Two routes disagree
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Some methods that infer the current expansion rate from early-universe data and others that measure the late universe give differing results. Researchers are testing possible explanations.

misconception: A learner may choose: Proof that galaxies do not exist
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What is the Hubble tension?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What is the Hubble tension? A persistent discrepancy between some early- and late-universe estimates of the expansion rate. Some methods that infer the current expansion rate from early-universe data and others that measure the late universe give differing results. Researchers are testing possible explanations.
